author: 5kO0
content:
Signed commit construction parity locked in.

Three layered checks added:

1. differential_unsigned_commit_signing_bytes — DAG-CBOR signing bytes byte-for-byte equal across impls. The trust model rests on this — if signing bytes differ, signatures from one impl don't verify on the other. Two fixtures (genesis with prev=null, with_prev with non-null prev CID).

2. differential_signed_commit_cid_with_fixed_sig — given the same UnsignedCommit fields and a Rust-generated P-256 signature, both impls compute the same SignedCommit CID. (Pinned sig because ECDSA is non-deterministic.)

3. differential_signed_commit_cross_impl_verification — Rust signs with both K-256 and P-256, TS verifies via verifyCommitSig with the corresponding did:key. End-to-end interop validation including the negative path (tampered rev string → TS must reject).

TS-side ops added (ts-runner/index.mjs):
- commit_signing_bytes — cborEncode of unsigned commit
- commit_signed_cid — cidForRecord of {unsigned, sig}
- commit_verify_sig — verifyCommitSig({unsigned, sig}, did_key)
- unsignedCommitFromInput helper validates {did, data, rev, prev} input strictly

Verification: TS_RUNNER_READY=1 cargo test -p proto-blue-interop-tests --tests passes 25 tests; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean.

This closes the #26/#27/#28 differential epic from the audit follow-up — full MST root-CID, CAR layout, and signed commit construction parity now exercised in CI.
